Subject: [ILUG] Job: Data Centre Technician

Hi guys,
I received the go ahead to put up an ad here for a job. Below is a
description of the job, the company is Amazon Ireland, or if you prefer,
amazon.com

Please mail any replies to me off list. Feel free to ask questions about the
position, and I'll do my best to answer them.

Data Center Technician,


Networking
•Experience with Cisco's CAT & Native IOS
• Switch Configuration and Troubleshooting
• Copper Cable Termination
• Understanding of Fiber Optic Cabling
• Experience with Cisco 6500, 3700 and 7600 Series Equipment

Systems
• General knowledge of Linux/Unix with Troubleshooting Experience
• Operational Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 2003 Server & Windows XP Pro
• Base Operating System Install
• System Administration
• Scripting; Perl, Python, Bash

Computer/Server Hardware
• HP/Compaq Proliant Servers – possess or obtain within three months of
hire, an APS certification on the Proliant products
• Knowledge of the x86 platform & SAN architecture

HVAC (Heating, Ventilating, and Air-Conditioning)
• Power Distribution Units (PDUs) & Uninterrupted Power Supplies (UPS)
• Fire Suppression Systems
• Diesel Generators
• Air Handlers and Chillers

Candidates need not be experts in all of the above, but the ideal candidate
would have experience with at least two of the above and show the
willingness and aptitude to learn what is required to become adequately
skilled in the other competencies.

A qualified candidate would be described as an individual who is a team
player, self-motivated and looking for a challenge. Strong communications
skills are a must; in a given shift the Data Center Technician is the Data
Center's primary point of contact for both internal customers (Network
Engineers, System Engineers & Administrators, Software Engineers, Database
Engineers and Systems/Networking Operations Center) and external customers
(Vendors & Contractors).


The responsibilities of the Data Center Technician extend beyond day to day
Data Center operations to include; process improvements, peer training, and
projects worked in conjunction with other groups.

24x7 environments and are staffed with Data Center Technicians around the
clock who are required to work twelve hour shifts that either start or end
on a weekend and rotate between three and four day work weeks.

Eamonn
